summary: Per-frame pit proximity pass over the active vehicle grid. First resets each entry of the current pit-state array (this+0x110, 8 bytes per entry, count this+0x10C) to state 0 via ShortComputation_0f00. Then iterates dword_5C329C vehicles from the dword_7C54F0 active-array, skipping vehicles in state 2, and computes an approach threshold from the vehicle's pit/session data at +15016 and the fields this+0xD4 and this+0xB0, with a session-specific clamp when dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7C56A8 == 5. When the vehicle's direction dot velocity (fields +164/+168/+172 by +13560/+13564/+13568) is below the threshold, the vehicle is mapped through DistanceProjectionCalc and CRTFtol into an array index this+0x10C range and its pit-state entry is written to state 2. Then a state-change pass compares this+0x110 against the previous-state array this+0x114 and raises PitSelectionStateMachine(dword_5EB978) on any transition. Finally, if anything changed or more than 5.0 elapsed since the last log, a ProgressBarEventEncode(...,4,10,...) heartbeat plus per-vehicle packed progress events are appended to the ring buffer anchored by dword_8AAE64/dword_83EE60 and the this+0x118 timestamp is refreshed. Called by sub_4D1D80 (004D1D80).

local_names.this: pit/session monitoring object carrying the pit-state arrays
local_names.i: loop index over the current pit-state array reset pass
local_names.j: loop index over the active vehicle grid
local_names.v5: active vehicle pointer from the dword_7C54F0 array
local_names.v6: per-vehicle pit/session data pointer at vehicle+15016
local_names.v7: approach threshold (distance/speed) accumulated in double precision
local_names.v9: state-array index computed from the projection
local_names.v13: current pit-state entry id from this+0x110
local_names.v15: previous pit-state entry id from this+0x114
local_names.k: loop index for packing per-vehicle progress-bar events
local_names.v20: global time (dbl_8AFEA0) passed as the event float

operations.description: Reset pass: for each of this+0x10C entries, ShortComputation_0f00(this+0x110 + 8*i, 0) clears the per-vehicle pit-state entry
Vehicle pass: iterate j over dword_5C329C vehicles taken from the dword_7C54F0 active-vehicle array
Skip vehicles whose state at +16484 equals 2; keep the current vehicle otherwise
v6 = the vehicle's pit/session data pointer at vehicle+15016
Approach threshold v7: when *(v6+300) is set, v7 is -1.0 if vehicle+13388 is set, else this+0xD4 * 0.5; otherwise v7 is *(v6+140) - 60.0 floored at *(v6+140) * 0.22499999
Session clamp: if dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7C56A8 == 5 and dbl_8AFEA0 < this+0xB0 + 20.0, clamp v7 down to (dbl_8AFEA0 - this+0xB0) * 6.0 - 10.0

When the dot product of direction (+164/+168/+172) with vehicle velocity (+13560/+13564/+13568) is below v7, compute v8 = DistanceProjectionCalc(vehicle+12), then v9 = CRTFtol(v8 * this+0x108) - 1 clamped into 0..this+0x10C-1, and write pit-state 2 into this+0x110 + 8*v9 via ShortComputation_0f00
The state-change pass only runs when the entry count this+0x10C is greater than 0 (packet guard)

State-diff loop: for each index up to this+0x10C, compare the new id from this+0x110 + 8*k against the previous id in this+0x114 + 4*k; on a difference raise PitSelectionStateMachine(dword_5EB978, curId, prevId, entryTime, 0, 0), copy the new id back into this+0x114, and set the changed flag
Ring-buffer flush gate: run the logging block when the changed flag is set or dbl_8AFEA0 - this+0x118 is greater than 5.0
Refresh the this+0x118 timestamp to dbl_8AFEA0 and advance the ring buffer: increment dword_83EE60 (capped at 1023) and advance the dword_8AAE64 cursor by 432 bytes
ProgressBarEventEncode(v16, 4, 10, 0, 255, globalTime, 0) writes the heartbeat progress event for the pass

Per-vehicle packing loop: for each of this+0x10C entries with a non-zero id, pack id + (k << 6) into the event word slot; every 16 packed entries advance the ring buffer and emit ProgressBarEventEncode(...,4,11,...), resetting the pack counter
Invoked by sub_4D1D80 (004D1D80) as the pit proximity detection stage
